entries.title: Job 7:1
segments: ¶"[Is there] not a time of hard service for man on earth? [Are not] his days also like the days of a hired man?

entries.title: Job 7:2
segments: Like a servant who earnestly desires the shade, And like a hired man who eagerly looks for his wages,

entries.title: Job 7:3
segments: So I have been allotted months of futility, And wearisome nights have been appointed to me.

entries.title: Job 7:4
segments: When I lie down, I say, 'When shall I arise, And the night be ended?' For I have had my fill of tossing till dawn.

entries.title: Job 7:5
segments: My flesh is caked with worms and dust, My skin is cracked and breaks out afresh.

entries.title: Job 7:6
segments: "My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, And are spent without hope.

entries.title: Job 7:7
segments: ¶Oh, remember that my life [is] a breath! My eye will never again see good.

entries.title: Job 7:8
segments: The eye of him who sees me will see me no [more; While] your [eyes] are upon me, I shall no longer [be].

entries.title: Job 7:9
segments: [As] the cloud disappears and vanishes away, So he who goes down to the grave does not come up.

entries.title: Job 7:10
segments: He shall never return to his house, Nor shall his place know him anymore.

entries.title: Job 7:11
segments: "Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.title: Job 7:12
segments: [Am] I a sea, or a sea serpent, That You set a guard over me?

entries.title: Job 7:13
segments: When I say, 'My bed will comfort me, My couch will ease my complaint,'

entries.title: Job 7:14
segments: Then You scare me with dreams And terrify me with visions,

entries.title: Job 7:15
segments: So that my soul chooses strangling [And] death rather than my body.

entries.title: Job 7:16
segments: I loathe [my life]; I would not live forever. Let me alone, For my days [are but] a breath.

entries.title: Job 7:17
segments: ¶"What [is] man, that You should exalt him, [That] You should set Your heart on him,

entries.title: Job 7:18
segments: That You should visit him every morning, [And] test him every moment?

entries.title: Job 7:19
segments: How long? Will You not look away from me, And let me alone till I swallow my saliva?

entries.title: Job 7:20
segments: Have I sinned? What have I done to You, O watcher of men? Why have You set me as Your target, So that I am a burden to myself?

entries.title: Job 7:21
segments: Why then do You not pardon my transgression, And take away my iniquity? For now I will lie down in the dust, And You will seek me diligently, But I [will] no longer [be]."
